def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    start = player_id * 6
    other = (1 - player_id) * 6
    board = state_view.board
    own = board[start:start + 6]
    opp = board[other:other + 6]
    store_lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[1 - player_id]
    side_lead = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    total = sum(own) + sum(opp)
    mobility = (1 if own[0] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[1] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[2] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[3] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[4] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[5] > 0 else 0)
    other_mobility = (1 if opp[0] > 0 else 0) + (1 if opp[1] > 0 else 0) + (1 if opp[2] > 0 else 0) + (1 if opp[3] > 0 else 0) + (1 if opp[4] > 0 else 0) + (1 if opp[5] > 0 else 0)
    score = 2.8 * store_lead + 0.18 * side_lead / (1 + total) + 0.22 * (mobility - other_mobility)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, score / 3.0))

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    captured = state_view.captured
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    seed_diff = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    total = sum(own) + sum(opp)
    mobility_diff = (1 if own[0] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[1] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[2] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[3] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[4] > 0 else 0) + (1 if own[5] > 0 else 0) - (1 if opp[0] > 0 else 0) - (1 if opp[1] > 0 else 0) - (1 if opp[2] > 0 else 0) - (1 if opp[3] > 0 else 0) - (1 if opp[4] > 0 else 0) - (1 if opp[5] > 0 else 0)
    score = 0.78 * (captured[player_id] - captured[other]) + 0.24 * seed_diff / (1 + total) + 0.21 * mobility_diff
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, score))
